description: A React component implementing an interactive dialog adapter for Mattermost, handling dialog conversion, validation, form submission, lookup, refresh, and cancellation with backward compatibility and enhanced type safety.

classes.name: InteractiveDialogAdapter
classes.description: A React component class that adapts legacy interactive dialogs to the modern AppsForm system, supporting validation, form handling, lookup, refresh, and cancellation with backward compatibility.

methods.name: convertToAppForm
methods.description: Converts dialog elements and properties into an AppForm object, handling validation errors.

methods.name: processFormValues
methods.description: Normalizes and accumulates form values across multi-step dialogs.

methods.name: handleSubmissionError
methods.description: Handles errors from dialog submission responses, providing user-friendly messages.

methods.name: convertServerResponseToForm
methods.description: Converts server response data into an AppForm, updating current dialog elements.

methods.name: submitAdapter
methods.description: Handles form submission, including validation, error handling, and multi-step dialog flow.

methods.name: cancelAdapter
methods.description: Handles dialog cancellation, notifying server if configured, and clears accumulated state.

methods.name: performLookupCall
methods.description: Performs dynamic lookup for select fields, validating URLs and processing responses.

methods.name: refreshOnSelect
methods.description: Handles form refresh when fields with refresh=true are changed, updating the form dynamically.

methods.name: postEphemeralCallResponseForContext
methods.description: No-op method for legacy ephemeral responses.

methods.name: isValidLookupURL
methods.description: Validates if a URL is safe for lookup operations (HTTPS or plugin path).

methods.name: getSafeErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns a sanitized error message for display.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the AppsFormContainer with the generated form and handlers, or logs errors if form generation fails.
